material_dock_and_cmdtab.method: solid-colour borderless window behind the Dock, sample the Dock bg between icons (sRGB 0-255). Cmd-Tab panel fill over Electric Blue = Dock fill (59,75,216), i.e. same material.

fits.dark: out = 12 + 164*(in/255)^0.77 per channel on greys, plus saturation boost
fits.light: out = 38 + 0.75*in (linear on greys), plus saturation boost

material_dock_and_cmdtab.edge_profile_over_black_dark: 1 pt rim 104 at the top edge, then 30,22,18,16,14,13,12 per pt; bottom rim 65 then 26,20,17,15,14,13 upward
material_dock_and_cmdtab.blur: 8 pt bars stay fully resolved (plateaus reach the solid-colour levels), edges soften over about 2 pt: small blur, sigma about 1-2 pt; strong lens refraction within about 6 pt of the rounded edges (4 pt checker and 2 pt bars are distorted there)

hover_label.shape: capsule 26 pt tall (r 13) with a tail at the bottom centre: tail about 16 pt wide at the base, 6.5 pt tall, rounded tip; tip 2.5 pt above the Dock bg top (13 pt above the art top at tile 33)
hover_label.font: SF 14 pt regular (ink width 39.5 for Finder = 14 pt regular)
hover_label.glass: yes: a 4 pt checker and 2 pt bars show through, refracted at the edges, 1 pt light rim; very faint shadow (<=3 levels)
hover_label.left_dock: capsule right of the icon, 5.5 pt from the Dock bg, vertically centred on the icon, no tail seen
hover_label.timing: appears in the frame the pointer enters (R2); fade-out cosine 0.29 s (reconciliation-42.json)

press_state.effect: icon art multiplied by 0.475 (all channels, rms 0.4), no scale change
press_state.timing: on in 1 frame at mouse down, off in 1 frame at mouse up, no animation
press_state.long_press: holding opens the context menu (under 0.8 s)

context_menu.shape: glass bubble with a tail pointing at the icon (like the label), radius about 14 pt (visual)
context_menu.window: menu window x = icon centre - 40; window bottom = Dock bg top (1055); body inset 13 pt in the window; rows 24 pt, separators 11 pt
context_menu.tail: tip about 3 pt above the Dock bg, at the icon centre; body extends to the right of the icon (left edge = icon centre - 27)
context_menu.highlight: accent pill, as in normal menus
context_menu.submenu: normal rounded glass menu to the right, no tail

cmdtab_notes.radius: about 58 pt circle-equivalent (straight edge starts 56 pt from the corner)
cmdtab_notes.selection: squircle 120x120 centred on the icon (icon frame inset 4), corner superellipse n about 3, extent 46 pt (circle-equivalent 34)
cmdtab_notes.label: app name under the selected icon, SF 13 pt bold, white in dark, top 2.5 pt below the 128 frame, baseline y 631 (panel bottom 642)
cmdtab_notes.overflow: 16 apps: icons shrink to 94 (pitch 100), panel 34 pt from the screen sides, still one row
cmdtab_notes.quick_tap: Cmd+Tab released within 30 ms switches without showing the panel

autohide.trigger: pointer y >= 1105 (bottom 2 pt) anywhere along the bottom edge
autohide.hide: starts about 0.05 s after the pointer leaves, slide down 0.17 s: 1057 1060 1062 1068 1074 1080 1087 1090 1097 1103 gone

tile33.right_edge: 3.75 pt right of the art edge

attention.critical: jump 36 pt (tile 33) then rebounds 18 and 9 pt (heights halve): arcs 0.50 + 0.31 + 0.22 s = about 1.0 s, rest about 1.0 s, repeats every 2.0 s until the app is activated

drag_remove.lift: dragged icon keeps the Dock art size (no lift scale)
drag_remove.label: "Remove" bubble with a tail, same style as the hover label, above the dragged icon, shown while the icon is outside the Dock (seen 0.25 s after leaving)
drag_remove.drop: icon and label fade out linearly in 0.25 s; no poof cloud seen

stack.fan: items rise in an arc to the right, sizes 65.5 -> 78.3 pt bottom to top, vertical step 64.6 pt, glass capsule labels to the left, top item "Open in Finder"; Dock tile shows a chevron while open

grid.title: folder name centred at the top (y 620, 19 pt)
grid.shape: glass bubble with tail, radius about 28 pt (visual)

list.content: files (small icons), separator, Options >, Open in Finder
list.shape: same bubble as the context menu

stack.context_menu: Sort by (Name, Date Added, Date Modified, Date Created, Kind) | Display as (Folder, Stack) | View content as (Fan, Grid, List, Automatic) | Options > (Remove from Dock, Show in Finder) | Open "<folder>"

minimised_tile.min_to_app_0: own tile right of the separator, after the stacks, before Trash; tile = app tile (35x47 at 33)
minimised_tile.art: window thumbnail fitted to about 31 pt wide (1300x900 window -> 31x21.5), app icon about 10 pt at the bottom-right corner
